profile.name: Sarthak Mittal
profile.headline: Backend engineer who ships APIs, AI workflows and systems that stay up.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
highlights: Built backend systems for lead management platforms, enabling processing of 200 applications per day.
Developed and integrated 500+ production REST API endpoints supporting customer onboarding, loan processing, and document management workflows.
Reduced API response times by 40% by optimizing PostgreSQL queries and adding database indexes.
Developed an AI-based user workflow using RAG to simplify the end-to-end loan application journey.
Onboarded and integrated 2 NBFCs including Poonawalla Fincorp and Findoc into the loan-processing stack.
Automated 4+ recurring operational workflows, reducing manual effort for daily backend operations.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
highlights: Developed and maintained REST APIs and backend services supporting 2 internal business operations teams.
Resolved 150+ production issues across APIs, database queries, and application workflows, improving system stability and reducing recurring defects.
Collaborated with product and QA teams to design, implement, and test REST API integrations for new features.

projects.name: AI Contract Intelligence Platform
projects.oneLiner: Analyze PDF and DOCX contracts — summaries, clause extraction, risk flags and semantic Q&A.
highlights: Built a contract intelligence platform that analyzes PDF/DOCX documents to summarize contracts, extract clauses, identify potential risks, compare documents, and support semantic Q&A.
Developed an AI-powered analysis backend using Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Google Gemini for RAG chat, semantic search and automated legal document analysis.
Built asynchronous PDF/DOCX ingestion with embedding storage and HNSW-based vector indexing for contract Q&A and cross-document retrieval.

projects.name: AI Interview Simulator
projects.oneLiner: Mock interviews with dynamic questions, LLM evaluation, scoring and facial-expression analysis.
highlights: Developed a web-based interview simulator with AI-driven evaluation for real-time, accurate responses.
Integrated an LLM feedback system to deliver results with 96.4%+ response accuracy, plus facial-expression confidence scores for performance tracking.
Built a real-time analysis pipeline and a cross-platform React app that increased user engagement.

projects.name: Dealstack CRM
projects.oneLiner: Full-stack CRM for leads, deals and customer workflows with a live sales pipeline.
highlights: Built REST APIs in Node.js and Express with secure authentication and structured schemas for leads, deals and customers.
Designed a React frontend for tracking sales pipelines and customer interactions in one place.

projects.name: DELICIRO — Food Ordering Website
projects.oneLiner: Responsive food-ordering site with dynamic menus, reusable components and clean UI.
highlights: Built a fully functional food ordering website in React with dynamic menu listings and client-side state management.
Focused on systematic coding, advanced CSS and fast, cross-device layouts.

projects.name: Interactive Web Guitar
projects.oneLiner: SVG guitar strings that bend with the mouse and play a note when you pluck them.
highlights: Used GSAP to animate SVG paths so each string curves like a real pluck.
Mapped mouse interaction to audio playback while respecting browser autoplay rules.

projects.name: Sorting Visualizer
projects.oneLiner: Watch sorting algorithms step through an array — built as a teaching tool for beginners.
highlights: Visualized multiple sorting algorithms so you can see comparisons, swaps and time complexity in motion.
Shipped both a vanilla JS version and a React rewrite.

projects.name: Connect Four
projects.oneLiner: Classic Connect Four in the browser, with a focus on board state and win-detection algorithms.
highlights: Implemented game-board data structures and win/draw detection in React.
Used the project to practice algorithm optimization in a real UI, not just on paper.

projects.name: Hanging Man
projects.oneLiner: Hangman with a Dribbble-inspired UI, built in React and Vite.
highlights: Rebuilt hangman as a polished web game from a Dribbble design.
Handled keyboard input, remaining lives and word state in React.

projects.name: Tic-Tac-Toe Pro
projects.oneLiner: Classic tic-tac-toe that tracks scores and resets itself for the next round.
highlights: Built a complete browser game with score tallying and one-click reset.
Kept the UI simple so the game logic stays easy to follow.

projects.name: Car Parking
projects.oneLiner: Find and manage parking slots in a simple web app.
highlights: Modeled parking availability and booking in a lightweight frontend.
Deployed a live demo for quick walkthroughs.

projects.name: Order Some Happiness
projects.oneLiner: A small commerce-style storefront for browsing and placing orders.
highlights: Built a product listing and checkout-style flow in React.
Practiced component structure and cart-style state.

projects.name: Batuaa
projects.oneLiner: A Flutter wallet / expense app for tracking money on the go.
highlights: Built a mobile-first money tracker in Dart and Flutter.
Focused on a clean Material-style UI for everyday use.

projects.name: Beacon
projects.oneLiner: Share your live location with a group — a Flutter app still evolving.
highlights: Started a Flutter app for sharing location with a trusted group.
Designed around simple, real-world coordination rather than a social feed.

projects.name: Memory Game
projects.oneLiner: Flip cards, match pairs, and beat your last score.
highlights: Implemented card-matching state, timers and a replay loop.
Kept the interaction snappy so it feels like a game, not a form.

projects.name: News Web
projects.oneLiner: A news reader that pulls headlines into a clean browsing UI.
highlights: Fetched and rendered article cards with category-style browsing.
Practiced API consumption and list performance in React.

projects.name: TweetMimic
projects.oneLiner: A tweet-style composer and feed UI for practicing social layouts.
highlights: Recreated a timeline-style interface to study composition and feed UX.
Used it as a playground for component reuse and state.

projects.name: Notes Taker
projects.oneLiner: Capture, edit and keep notes in the browser.
highlights: Built a lightweight notes app with create, edit and persist flows.
Kept the UI minimal so writing stays the main action.

projects.name: Simon Game
projects.oneLiner: Repeat the color sequence before it gets away from you.
highlights: Implemented sequence generation, input checking and level-up logic.
Used it to practice event timing and game loops in vanilla JS.

projects.name: Budgeto
projects.oneLiner: A small budget tracker for income, spend and remaining balance.
highlights: Modeled income and expense entries with running totals.
Practiced simple financial UI without a heavy framework.
